## Purpose
`SavingsSource` (`economy.ts`) and `SpecChild.source` (`specs.ts`) are this subproject's "provenance" discriminants: a closed string-literal union naming WHERE a row's data came from (which intervention produced a saving, which scanner found a linked sub-spec), always paired with a doc comment enumerating what each literal means. They are consumed by a companion breakdown/row interface (`SavingsBySource`, `SpecChild`) that carries the source tag alongside the measured data, never standing alone.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 2
A `XxxSource` is a plain `export type Foo = "a" | "b" | "c";` (snake_case literals to match the Rust `serde` enum, e.g. `SavingsSource`) or an inline optional union field on the owning interface when it only has 2-3 members (`source?: "event" | "header" | "both"`). Either way it carries a doc comment naming the mirrored Rust type/enum and, for the inline form, a bullet list explaining each literal's meaning right above the field.

## How to apply
A new provenance discriminant is declared next to the interface it tags: promote it to a standalone exported `type XxxSource = ...` only once more than one interface needs to share it (following `SavingsSource`); otherwise keep it inline as an optional field on the owning interface, documented with one bullet per literal (following `SpecChild.source`).

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/economy.ts
```ts
/** Stable snake_case keys for `SavingsSource` (`mustard_core::economy`). */
export type SavingsSource =
  | "rtk_rewrite"
  | "model_routing_downgrade"
  | "bash_guard_block"
  | "budget_output_cut";

/** One row of the savings breakdown, keyed by intervention. */
export interface SavingsBySource {
  source: SavingsSource;
  tokens_saved: number;
  event_count: number;
}
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/types/specs.ts
```ts
  /**
   * Provenance of this row, surfaced by the Wave-6 union scanner:
   * - `"event"` — found only in the SQLite `spec.link` projection
   * - `"header"` — found only via the on-disk `### Parent:` header scan
   * - `"both"` — present in both sources (the normal case once the event
   *    store has caught up)
   *
   * Optional for backwards compatibility — payloads from the pre-Wave-6
   * backend command never populate this field.
   */
  source?: "event" | "header" | "both";
```
